query:
select (select count(*) from aarogyam.queue_tokens o
                   where o.branch_id = t.branch_id and o.day = t.day and o.id <> t.id
                     and o.token_number < t.token_number
                     and o.status in ('waiting', 'called', 'in_chair')) as "ahead!",
                  (select avg(extract(epoch from (e.ended_at - e.started_at)) / 60.0)::float8
                   from aarogyam.encounters e
                   where e.branch_id = t.branch_id and e.status = 'closed'
                     and e.ended_at > now() - interval '14 days'
                     and e.ended_at > e.started_at) as average
           from aarogyam.queue_tokens t where t.id = $1
